title.zh: 将帕赛市延伸至帕拉尼亚克市的Bay大道更名为Jose W. Diokno大道的法案
title.en: An Act Renaming Bay Boulevard Located in Pasay City, extending up to Parañaque City, as Jose W. Diokno Boulevard
title.orig: An Act Renaming Bay Boulevard Located in Pasay City, extending up to Parañaque City, as Jose W. Diokno Boulevard

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2007/ra_9468_2007.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。 源文存在同号重出的条款（第 2 条）：该处官方页面确有两段均标同一 Section 号，本库照录其 `no` 值（不改动官方编号），条文 `id` 以 `_2`「_3」后缀保证唯一。

text.en: The approximately 4.38 kilometer stretch of road located in the cities of Pasay and Para&ntildeaque, which is now known as Bay Boulevard and which begins at its intersection with Roxas Boulevard where Gil Puyat Avenue terminates (specifically from Roxas Boulevard heading west past the World Trade Center, veering south past the GSIS Complex to Libertad Channel - 1.45 kilometers) passing through CBP 1 Island "A" (Libertad Channel to Redemptorist Channel- 1.28 kilometers) and CBP 1 Island "B" and "C" (Redemptorist Channel to Asiaworld Property - 1.65 kilometers) , is hereby renamed as Jose W. Diokno Boulevard.
The Department of Public Works and Highways is hereby directed to place the appropriate street names and markers along Jose W. Diokno Boulevard.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
